object_description: flat two-storey cube crowned by six tent-roof-like ends
design_condition: the flat volume is placed compatibly on the property, keeping a wide green belt free along the path while its low height and depth take up a lot of ground

positive: The flat building is situated in a compatible location on the property
Reducing the volume to two floors has functional advantages
A wide green belt remains free along the path
Its design continues the park-like character with curved paths and trees
The sports areas, playground and school garden are well integrated into the overall facility
The location of the play belt makes sense
The two entrances run east-west with the more public uses on both sides of this passage-like access
The overarching cube shape with six tent-roof-like ends is striking and certainly creates identity
They determine the appearance like individual smaller school buildings
The considerations for clustering the school on just one floor are convincing
The floor plan offers a high degree of flexibility for long-term use
The distribution of space on the ground floor is well done
The two central staircases are reached via sufficiently sized foyers
The roof shapes promise a nice atmosphere on the upper floors appealing to younger students
The room programme is adhered to and cost-effectiveness appears to be there
A good energy balance can be expected from the building structure
Making the sloping roof shape usable for air flow and night cooling is a good consideration
The footprint is quite appropriate compared to designs using two structures
negative: The two-storey reduction takes up a lot of property space
The dimensions of the play belt still need to be revised
The southern connection to the surroundings should be specified
The trees are too densely planted to the south and towards the neighbouring area
The rhythmised glass surfaces and the windows in the squinting wall surfaces lack the quality of the roof idea
The very small inner courtyards cannot ensure sufficient lighting of the interior rooms
All rooms with windows should have been oriented towards the green space, the real capital of the property
How a cost-effective fire protection view into the gymnasium works still needs discussion
Whether a generous line of sight makes educational sense still needs discussion
The footprint is relatively large due to the two-storey and deep structure
